slide.title: The popover lives on the page, not in the frame
slide.takeaway: The server renders each note into an inert template; the page script measures a copy of the SVG and shows one popover beside the hotspot.

item.label: Notes come from the diagram source
item.description: A projected slide now keeps its diagram pin, so both deck viewers read the source's notes and render each with the sanitizing Markdown helper.

item.label: Inert templates beside landmarks
item.description: Each Item's landmark carries a popover template with its label, description, callout body, and note; noted elements no Item selects get a hidden note target. The review drawer panel shows the note too.

item.label: Hotspots for noted elements
item.description: The script measures noted elements the way it measures Item elements, adds focusable note hotspots beneath Item hotspots, and drives the popover on hover, focus, tap, and Escape.

item.label: Every Item hotspot now previews
item.description: Why existing decks change even without notes.
item.body: You might expect only noted elements to change; every Item hotspot now shows its label and description on hover, so existing decks gain previews too.

item.label: One popover, placed beside
item.description: A single fixed popover on the page, placed below, above, right, or left of the hotspot, so a click still reaches the hotspot and opens its drawer.

item.label: Server and browser tests
item.description: A tampered source reaches the page only as sanitized, escaped HTML; the browser test hovers, tabs to, taps, and dismisses notes on review and implementation decks.
